## How to cite

If you use EnerHabitat in academic work, please cite the reference paper
[@barrios2016]:

> Barrios, G., Casas, J.M., Huelsz, G., Rojas, J. (2016). *Ener-Habitat: An online
> numerical tool to evaluate the thermal performance of homogeneous and
> non-homogeneous envelope walls/roofs*. Solar Energy 131, 296–304.
> <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.solener.2015.12.017>

```bibtex
@article{Barrios2016,
  author  = {Barrios, G. and Casas, J.M. and Huelsz, G. and Rojas, J.},
  title   = {Ener-Habitat: An online numerical tool to evaluate the thermal
             performance of homogeneous and non-homogeneous envelope walls/roofs},
  journal = {Solar Energy},
  volume  = {131},
  pages   = {296--304},
  year    = {2016},
  doi     = {10.1016/j.solener.2015.12.017}
}
```

To cite the software itself, use the
[`CITATION.cff`](https://github.com/Ener-Habitat/EnerHabitat/blob/main/CITATION.cff)
at the repository root (GitHub's *Cite this repository* button generates BibTeX/APA
from it).

## Changelog

See the full
[CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Ener-Habitat/EnerHabitat/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

- **0.2.1** — documentation release: this site (theory, executable examples, API),
  restructured README, `CITATION.cff`; no changes to the solvers or the API.
- **0.2.0** — 2D constructive systems: `System2D`, `HollowBlock` (walls), `Slab`
  (joist-and-block roofs) with air or solid-filled cavities, 2D `solveAC()`,
  to-scale section inspector, `config2d`.
- **0.1.x** — 1D multilayer systems: `Location`, `System` (free-running and
  air-conditioned), global `config`, EPW + pvlib sun–air temperature,
  finite-volume TDMA solver over an average day.
